content: Hi — I'm Cloris. Tell me about the role.
Tax associate — senior, staff, or open? And what kind of tax: sales, partnership, income, all of it?
Senior sales tax associate. Multi-state, single state, or one big state with carve-outs?
Twelve states is real volume — does the new hire own filings end-to-end, or backfill the Director on edge cases?
End to end. Director only on edge cases.
Got it — end to end on twelve states, Director on edges only. What's the bar for an edge case — a new state, a sourcing-rule change, or just a number that looks weird?

capability_areas.name: Multi-state sales tax
capability_areas.description: Owns filings across twelve states end-to-end. Director steps in only on edge cases.

depth_distinction.builder_definition: Owns the twelve-state filing process from intake to filed return.
depth_distinction.user_definition: Operates the existing process; escalates edge cases to the Director.

content: New state or a sourcing-rule change. Numbers we handle ourselves.
New state or sourcing-rule change goes up — that's a clean line. I think I have what I need. Want to see the brief I'd run with?
